items.label: 25W Ultra‑Fast Wireless Charging
items.value: Charge your iPhone  17 Pro to 50% in just 22 minutess—exceeding the limits of standard 25W wireless charging with AirCool powered by aerospace-grade TEC. Enjoy faster charging with the convenience of wireless power, up to 6× faster than standard 5W wireless chargers. Actual performance may vary.

items.label: TÜV-Certified AirCool
items.value: Powered by aerospace-grade TEC, AirCool helps keep your phone below 89°F while charging for a cooler and more comfortable charging experience. Lower temperatures help support battery health and reduce long-term wear. Actual performance may vary.

items.label: Live Charging Display
items.value: Get real-time updates on power, temperature, and charging status with the built-in 1.65" HD display. Monitor the process, customize the screen, and stay in control at all times. Instant safety alerts also appear onscreen to help protect your device.

items.label: 3 Modes for All-Day Power
items.value: Switch between 3 smart charging modes to match your daily routine. Boost Mode delivers high-power charging to keep your phone cool during quick top-ups. Ice Mode provides maximum cooling with rapid charging performance, ideal for charging while in use. Sleep Mode turns off cooling and dims the display for quiet overnight charging.

items.label: Smart Interaction
items.value: Connect via NFC or Bluetooth in the Anker app to check charging status, switch modes, schedule day or night cycles that automatically enter or exit Sleep Mode, set screensavers, and more. With NFC quick launch, a single tap connects you instantly.

items.label: What You Get
items.value: Anker Prime Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, MagGo, AirCool, Dock Stand), 65W GaN foldable adapter, 5 ft USB-C to USB-C cable (10,000-bend tested), welcome guide, 24-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.
